title: DR1 gives the four things that can identify the transport as a bulleted list; the frontend runs all four into one parenthetical sentence separated by semicolons.

finding.frontend: The hint under "Transport identification" is one unbroken sentence: "To identify the means of transport, enter (one of the following): flight number; train number; road vehicle registration number; vessel name (for ferries, also the road vehicle registration number)" (src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/transport/copy/copy.en.js:24-27). It wraps to three lines on the captured page, carries two sets of brackets and nests one inside the other, so the four choices have to be picked apart from a run of semicolons.
finding.prototype: DR1 breaks the same content in two: a lead line "To identify the means of transport, enter (one of the following):" and then a bulleted list of four items — flight number, train number, road vehicle registration number, and vessel name (for ferries, also the road vehicle registration number) (app/views/arrival-details.html:128).
finding.difference: Split the hint into a lead sentence and a four-item bulleted list, keeping the wording as it is. The frontend already renders bulleted guidance this way on its own transporter page, so the pattern is in hand.
finding.falsifiedBy: Finding a list element inside the transport-identification hint on fe-arrival-details — the captured DOM renders that hint as a single govuk-hint div of running text.
